question: In what form is the vital air said to be present within all living beings?
premises: The subject is the air filled with breath
It is situated in all beings
Its presence is universal among living beings
inference: The breath-filled vital air abides in all living beings.
uncertainties: Agreement between vāyuḥ and saṃsthitam is unusual; taken as describing the situated principle.
plain_english: The breath-filled vital air is situated in all living beings.
